children: Furlenco is reportedly preparing a Rs 1,000-1,200 crore IPO in FY28 at a targeted Rs 7,000 crore valuation after strong FY26 growth

Furniture and appliance rental startup Furlenco is reportedly preparing to launch an initial public offering of Rs 1,000-1,200 crore, with the company targeting a valuation of around Rs 7,000 crore through the proposed issue, as per a media report

The Bengaluru-based startup is looking to launch the IPO in FY28 and is expected to appoint ICICI Securities as an advisor for the public issue, according to the report. The final valuation is likely to be determined closer to the IPO based on market conditions and investor feedback during roadshows

Founded in 2012 by Ajith Mohan Karimpana, Furlenco operates a subscription-based furniture and appliance rental platform. The company offers more than 300 SKUs across 28 cities, including Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Chennai and Kolkata. It also sells new furniture alongside its rental business

Furlenco's operating revenue rose 61.9 per cent year-on-year to Rs 370.4 crore in FY26 from Rs 228.7 crore in FY25. Its net profit increased nearly 20 times to Rs 59.5 crore from Rs 3.1 crore during the same period
The company's EBITDA nearly doubled to Rs 129.5 crore in FY26 from Rs 66.4 crore in FY25, while its EBITDA margin expanded to 35.01 per cent

Furniture and office equipment rentals contributed around 92 per cent of Furlenco's operating revenue in FY26. Rental income increased 64 per cent year-on-year to Rs 341.1 crore, while revenue from furniture sales rose 38 per cent to Rs 29.4 crore
Furlenco's total expenditure increased 45.1 per cent year-on-year to Rs 343.9 crore in FY26 from Rs 236.9 crore in FY25

The company raised Rs 125 crore in a funding round led by existing investor Sheela Foam, with participation from Whiteoak and Madhu Kela, in December 2025. The capital was intended to support expansion in existing and new markets, product innovation, technology and customer experience
Furlenco has raised more than USD 290 million in funding to date from investors including Lightbox Ventures, Crescent Ventures, Whiteoak and Madhu Kela

The proposed IPO comes shortly after furniture rental rival RentoMojo raised Rs 1,255.6 crore through its public issue. RentoMojo's IPO was subscribed 72.88 times and its shares listed at Rs 482.45 on the NSE, a 19.42 per cent premium over the issue price of Rs 404

Several other Indian startups are also preparing to tap the public markets. Moneyview is set to open its IPO on September 24, while Snapdeal parent AceVector is scheduled to open its public issue on September 25
Used-car marketplace Spinny has also filed confidential IPO papers for a proposed Rs 2,500-3,000 crore issue.
